job.what: Construct the dvsa-mot-next-test-outcome artifact on a worker (repair relaunch dvsa-mot-build-004; the only construction change vs build-003 is the macOS junk-member skip: build-003 PROVED the Deflate64 repair on the real 2017 DfT zip - 38,056,161 rows parsed with 2015/2016 receipts reproduced exactly (ABRVE 242/27) - then died at the 2018 zip's first member, __MACOSX/._dft_test_result-from-2018-01-01...csv, an AppleDouble resource fork whose bytes cannot map to the CSV schema (measured, collected container.log staging 437475493); open_text_lines now skips __MACOSX/ and ._-prefixed members before any decode, every other unexpected member still fails loudly; the Deflate64 route, ABRVE value rule, label rule, pre-registered triad and deciding rule are unchanged): download the 20 per-year DVSA/DfT anonymised MOT result files (2005-2016 txt.gz + 2017-2022 zips at data.dft.gov.uk, 2023-2024 zips at the DVSA S3 origin; the 2024 zip byte-pinned to the 2026-10-19 measurement), stream-parse class-4 rows of md5-sampled vehicles (~0.1%), join consecutive completed tests per vehicle, label the next test's initial failure (F/PRS vs P), features strictly from the prior test and earlier, splits by prior-test year (train 2009-2018 / eval 2019-2021 / holdout 2022-2023.11, right-censoring cutoff 2023-11-30), then run the gate 1.5.0 on the FULL artifact on the worker, --accept the exact bytes, and compute the pre-registered reference triad (post-acceptance). No performance metric exists before acceptance; the deciding model-vs-triad check runs in a later baseline job.
job.stopping_condition: a failed build or gate stops the job with the reports preserved for collection; a failed gate is a recorded finding requiring diagnosis before any rebuild; no re-tuning of threshold, window, label or features after any score.
